methodology.candidate_universe: Exactly the 64 records identified by the locked Stage 2 candidate_indices; no additions or removals.
methodology.context_evaluation_line: CORE if its locked historical HR is at least 12/20; otherwise FLOOR if it meets the Stage 2 14/20 carry rule. This is a reference line for context analysis, not a final selection.
methodology.classification: Supportive, Mixed, or Concern; each record includes factor classifications for role/workload, availability/status, matchup/competition, game environment/script and weather.
methodology.historical_integrity: No historical HR, L20 observation, Stage 1 qualification or Stage 2 alternate band was changed.
methodology.data_gaps: Current-season usage was not independently verified for several Tennessee receivers and some secondary roles; those are marked Mixed/Concern. Weather forecasts are snapshots as of October 16.
methodology.source_mismatch: Marvin Harrison Jr. remains in the locked candidate set, but his recorded ARI team conflicts with the HOU-JAX game. He is marked Concern and no matchup conclusion is inferred.
